notes.title: SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim is out now!
notes.content:
[h2]You opened your eyes to find a giant girl looking down at you...[/h2]
[previewyoutube=6xfS4I5I3D8;full][/previewyoutube]
We are pleased to announce that SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim, an adventure game about little people shrunk to the size of a thumb and the giant girl Saeko, is officially available starting today.
To celebrate the launch, we're offering a 10% discount for the next 14 days.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492120/SAEKO_Giantess_Dating_Sim/
You’ve been shrunk down to the size of a thumb—how many more days can you survive in Saeko’s world?
And when you find yourself in a position to sway their destinies, who will you choose to save?

We invite you to experience the fate of Saeko and the little people in this cruel yet captivating story, brought to life by avant-garde art.

notes.title: Steam Next Fest special streaming
notes.content:
[h3]SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim joins the Steam Next Fest![/h3]
Experience the fate of Saeko and little people with an avant-garde art style and brutal yet captivating storytelling.
During the event, streamers from around the world will play the demo version.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492120/SAEKO_Giantess_Dating_Sim/


[u][b]About the Game[/b][/u]
SAEKO: Giantess Dating Sim is an adventure game set in 2000s Japan about the life of Saeko, a girl with strange abilities, and a group of little people who have shrunk to the size of her thumb.
You play as Rin, a new member protected by Saeko, who lives in a desk drawer with other people.
But be careful. Saeko seems to have a few ...... unusual hobbies.

Cheers!

notes.title: Regarding videos/streaming and derivative work for this game
notes.content:
Thank you for considering video-posting/streaming or derivative works for our game!
We welcome and appreciate almost every collaboration, but please review the following guidelines before you do it.

[h3]Video Posting and Live Broadcasting[/h3]
We welcome video posting and live broadcasting of this game! It's ok to monetize your work through advertisements and donations too.
However, please observe the following two points when you do it:

1. Please include the following link in the description of your video or livestream.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2492120/SAEKO_Giantess_Dating_Sim/

2. This work is heavily influenced by novels by Sizue Fuechi. Please respect him, and don't do anything that can hurt his dignity or personality.

Note: well, you can hurt SAFE HAVN STUDIO instead, the developers of this game (within the bounds of law and common sense, of course).

◯ "Whoever made this game must be quite a pervert."
✗ "Whoever wrote the original story must be quite a pervert."

[h3]Illustrations, Doujinshi, Goods production etc.[/h3]
You can freely create derivative works such as illustrations, novels, and goods!
You can distribute your works for a fee, whether through physical media or downloads, as long as the activities are within the scope of personal hobbies. You can also earn revenue through paid sites such as Fanbox and Skeb.
However, please refrain from using official materials as is. Also, please refrain from using expressions that can damage Sizue Fuechi.

[h3]Singing and/or soundtrack remixes[/h3]
You can freely sing or remix our soundtrack, and publish it on internet!
You can distribute your works for a fee, whether through physical media or downloads, as long as the activities are within the scope of personal hobbies. You can also earn revenue through paid sites such as Fanbox and Skeb.
You can sample our songs and soundtracks too -- but don't make anything that can damage Sizue Fuechi.
